purpose: Replace the unclear V41 recording and charging ornaments with readable, face-independent V9-style source components. The generated sheet contains no face and cannot be a runtime card.

locked_v9_reference.use: sole reference for black ink weight, soft cute geometry, monochrome contrast, and whitespace; do not reproduce or modify the character face

reference_policy: The locked V9 sheet is the sole visual reference. Historical/rejected extension art, V10+, legacy art, V41 preview frames, and complete faces are not prompt inputs or visual fallbacks.

source_sheet.recording_contract: Each top-row cell contains a compact upright microphone with one to three short incoming sound-wave marks. It will later sit outside the lower-right cheek safe zone, so its source silhouette must be compact, balanced, and readable without touching a face. The three cells increase input activity, not output broadcast.
source_sheet.charging_contract: Each bottom-row cell contains one compact bottom wireless charging cradle: a shallow U-shaped dock with two small contact marks and one to three small rising charge marks. It will later sit under the face, so it must read as a dock/charging action rather than a happy expression, plug beside an eye, battery, or generic sparkle.
